chapter: Bucking contests, boogie woogie and rhythm
title: What boogie woogie was called, and where it came from
summary: He knew only Dixieland and blues in New Orleans, and traces boogie woogie to Chicago and Harlem, with night rounds in Harlem with Jack Teagarden.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Where the blues came from: Handy, Bolden and early blues
